evidence.note: Consolidates the exact S410/S417 Woven neckline clip and S419 Polo H segmented-locator decisions; no implementation, status, gate or hold changes.

text: S422 binds two still-distinct design choices to exact current evidence: Woven neckline clipping versus continuous seam/hold (S410/S417), and the source-preserving variable-arc Polo H locator versus continuous-ring hold (S419). Neither is settled by the already-approved collar-over-plackets mapping. No implementation or face release; all V02 gates remain unchanged.
